intent: An unconditional ALLOW plus a DENY on !has(aOptionalString): the DENY arrives as not(not(has)), which the planner folds to has().

plannerDivergence.issue: has() over an omitted attribute: unknown to the planner, absent to check()
plannerDivergence.reason: Before 0.57.0 the planner folds has() to true and drops the DENY, so the plan is KIND_ALWAYS_ALLOWED. The per-row check() calls send the omitted aOptionalString as absent, so the DENY matches and check() denies a2, a4, a8, c2 and e1. From 0.57.0 the plan carries the has().

trap: Before 0.57.0 the DENY was dropped from the plan, granting every row; a translation that loses the double negation, or reads has() as always true, grants a2, a4, a8, c2 and e1.
